most_likely_explanation: A ~614-648 ppm, 2.4-h, 6.7036-d box-shaped dimming whose lost light (1.05 +/- 0.15 e/s in an independent three-source PRF fit to the host TPFs; 1.32 +/- 0.34 e/s whole-stamp; 1.07 PSF; 1.04 SAP) is located at the target to Kepler's ~1-pixel precision and is absent from both bright neighbours' own light curves. It behaves like a transit of a ~2.2 Re body with b ~ 0.65 on the G=17.1 dwarf, but a blended eclipsing source within ~4 arcsec cannot be excluded by Kepler pixels; it stays a signal until a documented TRICERATOPS FPP/NFPP run.
surviving_strengths: Not known: no KOI/DR25 TCE/Kepler EB row for KIC 9655224, 9655236 or 9655226; no ephemeris match at P, P/2, 2P, P/3, 3P anywhere in the field (nearest period coincidences have epoch offsets 4.5-8.6 h and are 52-163 arcmin away; the 3.35-d EB KIC 9719636 would also put a ghost at phase 0.5 where the fold shows -29 ppm); SIMBAD empty at the target; Gaia DR3 target has RUWE 1.04, ipd_frac_multi_peak 0, non_single_star 0; Bienias & Szabo 2025 / Moquin 2026 excluded by period and depth regime (redteam/catalog_check.log).

Pixel origin (own code, independent of pipeline/pixel_vet.py, redteam/pixel_fit.log): joint Gaussian-PRF amplitudes target 1.05 +/- 0.15 e/s, G=15.9 neighbour 0.39 +/- 0.18, host -0.06 +/- 0.14; target-only beats neighbour-only by dchi2 = 46 (375 vs 421, null 444); pixel nearest target 0.49 +/- 0.08 e/s vs 0.19 +/- 0.09 and 0.08 +/- 0.07 for the neighbours; whole-stamp unclipped deficit 1.32 +/- 0.34 e/s vs 1.07 expected. The pipeline's own pixel.json summed over 10 quarters agrees (Gaussian-at-target chi2 299.5 vs 328.6 at the G=15.9 star, 340.9 at the host); its unfavourable deficit-centroid statistic is edge-biased (target 0.3-1.3 px from the stamp edge) and pixel_vet.py's deficit_total_e_s is a positive-clipped sum, not light lost.

Neighbours' own KBONUS light curves at the target ephemeris, all quarters (redteam/neighbour_allq.log): KIC 9655226 (G 15.9, 5.3 arcsec) PSF 0.43 +/- 0.23 e/s (>= 4 sigma below the >= 2 e/s it would need as the origin), host KIC 9655236 -0.15 +/- 0.12 e/s.

EB diagnostics: no secondary at any phase (max 150 ppm at phase 0.16, 1.7 sigma), odd/even 0.33-0.39 sigma, flat bottom preferred over full V by dchi2 9.0, duration 2.33-2.44 h consistent with a 0.83 Rsun dwarf at b ~ 0.65 (central T14 3.1 h); SAP/PSF depth ratio 0.46 as expected (300 +/- 34 vs 648 +/- 89 ppm).

Systematics: no depth dependence on gap proximity (Spearman -0.09, p 0.34), trend -1.2 sigma, signal present in all four seasons/channels (ch 23/39/47/63), in-transit cadences not correlated with desaturations (z -1.1) or any other Kepler quality flag beyond z 2.6 among 11 tests; dropping the 5 highest-SNR events still leaves 429 +/- 75 ppm; median-based depth (644) equals mean-based (648).
No stellar variability at P or harmonics (LS rank 9018/200000 at P; peak at 37 d is quarter-scale systematics); blind BLS SDE 15.6 vs inverted-null 7.1 (re-derivation) and 125 distinct events.
